28.name: Jaylin Lane
28.comment: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

28.name: Sonny Styles
28.comment: Styles finished Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers with 13 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense.

28.name: Drew Stevens
28.comment: Stevens made his only field-goal try and converted both of his extra-point attempts during Monday's 23-17 loss at San Francisco.

28.name: Austin Ekeler
28.comment: Ekeler logged a three-yard carry and caught both of his targets for four yards during the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday.

28.name: Dyami Brown
28.comment: Brown hauled in his only target for six yards during Monday's 23-17 loss versus San Francisco.

28.name: Jeremy McNichols
28.comment: McNichols accrued five rushes for 13 yards during Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers.

28.name: Terry McLaurin
28.comment: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.

28.name: Charles Omenihu
28.comment: questionable

28.name: Marcus Mariota
28.comment: doubtful

28.name: Treylon Burks
28.comment: Burks finished with four receptions for 66 yards on six targets in Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers.

28.name: Antonio Williams
28.comment: Williams brought in three of four targets for 50 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

28.name: Chig Okonkwo
28.comment: Okonkwo brought in all seven targets for 69 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

28.name: Rachaad White
28.comment: White rushed seven times for 27 yards and brought in four of five targets for 30 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

28.name: Jayden Daniels
28.comment: Daniels completed 29 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding four rushes for 10 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

28.name: Javon Kinlaw
28.comment: Kinlaw (knee) won't return to Washington's matchup versus the 49ers on Monday, John Keim of ESPN reports.

28.name: Tyler Owens
28.comment: Owens (hamstring) is active for Monday night's game against the 49ers.

28.name: Percy Butler
28.comment: Butler (hamstring) is active for Monday night's game against the 49ers.

28.name: Javontae Jean-Baptiste
28.comment: The Commanders placed Jean-Baptiste (pectoral) on injured reserve Monday.

28.name: Jordan Magee
28.comment: The Commanders activated Magee (hamstring) from injured reserve, and he is active for Monday night's game against the 49ers.

28.name: Nick Cross
28.comment: Cross (illness) is active for Monday night's game against the 49ers.

28.name: Trey Amos
28.comment: Amos (ankle) was activated from injured reserve by Washington on Monday.
